prior approval is not unrestricted permission for unrelated development
farm tracks can fall within Part 6 only where applicable conditions are met
Agricultural EIA can remain a separate requirement

core_rules: agricultural PD is not unrestricted development
prior approval is not full planning application
Part6 does not replace agricultural EIA
Part6 does not replace heritage consent
Part6 does not establish highway access
farm track PD is not universal

no parcel agricultural-PD clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
